labs.task: Prepare a small explainer from two accessible sources, then deliver it and answer unprepared questions.
deliverables: One corrected attempt and support log
conditions: Use a verified speaker or recording for listening.
Keep observable performance separate from confidence.

labs.name: B1 consolidation: explain, interact and learn independently: transfer
labs.task: Repeat the core functions on a new topic with reduced scaffolding and a delayed follow-up.
deliverables: One corrected attempt and support log
conditions: Use a verified speaker or recording for listening.
Keep observable performance separate from confidence.

questions.prompt: Does agreement between sources prove every claim true?
Can reading the article first make the related audio easier?

assessments.task: Answer from memory, then explain or correct the answer with feedback.
pass_criteria: Both answers substantively correct after feedback; flag whether correction was assisted.
assessments.mastery_note: Knowledge checks alone cannot establish practical mastery.

questions.prompt: Is reading a full written script equivalent to explaining from notes?
Write two brief Arabic signposts that organise a two-part explanation.

assessments.task: Answer before revealing keys; try the Arabic application prompt where present, then explain or correct errors. Record independent answers separately from corrections.
pass_criteria: All question responses substantively correct after feedback; preserve the independent first attempt and flag every assisted correction.
assessments.mastery_note: Written knowledge and application checks support only the observed evidence dimensions. They do not establish listening, pronunciation, spontaneous interaction or independent transfer by themselves.
